audited_coupling.sign_conventions: Iremote=(Vlrp+Vlrn−1.8V)/50Ω, positive from remote nodes into 0.9V VCM; Ilocal=sum((VDD−Vpad)/R). Estimated Itail=Ilocal−Iremote; pad/channel stored-charge derivatives and other paths are omitted.
limitations: 10nF caps and RLC initial state may retain long charge history; no microsecond steady-state claim or old 45-point failure assertion.
Generic50 linear-R extrapolation below 0.1V and reverse bias follows prior planning estimate; actual local capacitive currents omitted.
Integral Iremote is charge into the remote VCM resistors in the recorded interval; it is not measured capacitor charge or individual capacitor voltage.
Current imbalance includes pad and channel storage; estimated tail is not measured transistor current.
Time weighted waveform averages, not independent statistical samples.

scope: Local output-state comparison only; no full serializer source impedance, noise/mismatch/PEX, power-up proof or fixed-resistor adoption.

limits.limitation: Model validity and preferred use are not EM, thermal, layout, mismatch or reliability signoff. Parallel equal current sharing is assumed; altered fixed R network may change waveforms and has not been simulated.

interpretation: Old 45 records cover a finite turn-on/charge history. Native resistor conduction and tail currents are measured only in the new two-condition clean-input paired experiment. Peak-current equal-sharing counts are planning values, not AC EM or physical fixed-resistor qualification.
